tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm paper in light, deep ink in dark. The classroom desk sits on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines on `background`, `card` and `secondary`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels: shared lesson, attendance, discussion. Always with a 1px `border` rule, never a shadow.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dialogs (schedule, edit, end class) and menus.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Editorial red: the one primary action per view (Join class, Start lesson session), kickers, the live status. Text on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover on secondary buttons, evidence chips, the neutral badge ground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder grounds.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: host line, timestamps, helper text. On `background`, `card` and `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ochre accent; same value as `amber`. Pending and degraded fills.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill. Source pair is 3.7:1 in Paper: use at 19px bold or larger, or prefer `foreground` on a 10% `accent` tint.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and write failures (role=alert copy). Same red as `primary`: pair with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The thin editorial rule: card edges, list dividers, the secondary button outline is `foreground` instead.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders (class title, message box, link field). Source value is under 3:1 on `background` in Paper; every control keeps a visible label and the 2px `ring` on focus.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, 2–3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Muted green: saved, connected, receiving. Text on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Ochre: pending, degraded, measuring. Fills, tints, dots, bars and borders. Source value is 3.6:1 on `background` in Paper, so ochre TEXT uses `amber-text`; 9:1 in Ink.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Ochre for small text: the Experimental tag, the Inferred kind label, the correction icon. 5.7:1 on `background` and 6.0:1 on `card` in Paper, 9:1 in Ink. Use it wherever `amber` would be text under 19px bold.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary positive tone for badges; rarely used in the classroom.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm paper surface (compatibility alias of `background`).

tokens.name: paper-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-border
tokens.usage: Rules on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-subtle
tokens.usage: Subtle paper fill for the paper badge tone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink: the ink button fill and the ink badge; inverted text uses `background`.

tokens.name: sidebar-background
tokens.usage: Workspace sidebar ground around the classroom desk.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item (Classrooms).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Sidebar hover fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar rule.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Sidebar focus ring.

tokens.name: chart-human
tokens.usage: Chart marks for people: watchers, human uses of content. Marks only, never text; labels stay `foreground`/`muted-foreground`. Validated with `chart-agent` for colour-blind separation (ΔE 21+) and at least 3:1 on `card` in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-agent
tokens.usage: Chart marks for agents: agents working, agent uses of content, the unattended note's tint. Marks only; pair with the word *Agents* or the bot icon.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Broadcast stage ground behind host video and participant tiles, dark in both themes so video never sits on paper.

tokens.name: stage-raised
tokens.usage: Participant tile and control-bar ground on `stage`.

tokens.name: stage-border
tokens.usage: Tile edges and media-control outlines on `stage` and `stage-raised` (at least 3:1 on both).

tokens.name: stage-foreground
tokens.usage: Names, captions and control labels on `stage` and `stage-raised`.

tokens.name: stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `stage` and `stage-raised`: seat role, packet counts.

tokens.name: stage-live
tokens.usage: On-air red for the stage: the LIVE plate fill and the leave button. Always carries the word.

tokens.name: stage-live-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a `stage-live` fill.

tokens.name: stage-speaking
tokens.usage: Speaking ring (2px) and receiving bars on `stage`. Always paired with the mic icon or the word.

tokens.name: stage-caution
tokens.usage: Measuring or weak signal bars on `stage`, with the word.

tokens.name: stage-scrim
tokens.usage: Caption plate behind a name over live video. Text on it is `stage-foreground`.

styles.name: headline-3xl
styles.usage: The room title on the classroom page.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.usage: Panel and card headings, class titles in the list.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.usage: Small panel headings; the BuildAndDo wordmark in the header (tracking -0.025em).

styles.name: body-reading
styles.sample: Follow the section selected by the host.
styles.usage: Lesson section text in the shared lesson.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Members will no longer be able to join or post.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow in `primary` above a headline.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Uppercase badge and on-air plate text.

styles.name: status-label
styles.usage: Uppercase room status on class cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges and pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: title to meta, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, message dividers (pt-3), control bar gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards and tiles; field stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-5) and section stacks on the room page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Roomy card padding (p-6) and page stacks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Container side padding.

radius.note: The system is square: --radius is 0. Only dots and the speaking indicator are round.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every card, button, input, badge, tile and the stage.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the mic level dot only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. The only shadow is the input focus halo.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and textareas on focus-visible, beside the 2px `ring` outline.

tokens.name: rule-thin
tokens.usage: Default rule: card borders, list dividers.

tokens.name: rule-thick
tokens.usage: Section breaks under a masthead; the speaking ring on a tile.

tokens.name: rule-double
tokens.usage: Double rule (3px double, foreground at 70%) for major divisions.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button height (Refresh classrooms).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large button and media control height.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Right rail (attendance, discussion) beside the stage at xl.

tokens.name: feed-rail-width
tokens.usage: The Sentinel feed rail beside the stage and channel list at 900px and wider; below that the feed stacks under the stage.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max page width.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled-sm
tokens.usage: Disabled small controls.
